tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and slide background (Cream). The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, popups, the Ask alert background.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Tinted panels and the Info alert. On sand use ink for text, never ink-muted (4.45:1, just under AA).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, input and secondary-button borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text (Espresso) on surface, surface-raised and sand. Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: The brand colour: logo, app icon, big numbers and headings at 24px and up. Only 3.8:1 on cream, so never body-size text.

tokens.name: terracotta-text
tokens.usage: Terracotta at body size: the Ask alert's border, title and icon; links.

tokens.name: on-terracotta
tokens.usage: Icons and 24px+ text on a terracotta fill (the app icon's dog).

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Block alert fill: the loudest thing Senti shows. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-bark
tokens.usage: Text and the warning icon on a bark fill (5.2:1).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Accent: the bark waves, illustrations, small decorative fills. Never text on cream.

tokens.name: sage-text
tokens.usage: Allowed state text and icon, on surface or sage-soft.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Allowed state background.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, an alias of terracotta-text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px surface gap.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Deck cover and hero lines. One per page or slide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The agent tried to upload your .env file to an unknown website.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Rule: never send secrets outside this Mac.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: The command or file path an agent tried to use.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Alert inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Alert and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Popup padding, between sections of a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Slide margins, between big sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Code blocks, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, alerts, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popups, cards, cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills.
